Unkown3:
The real reality lay elsewhere.
What stood before me was a world I did not know.
Miriam said I had woken up after 15 years.
Judging by her manner, she did not seem to be joking...
Perhaps to lift the heavy mood,
Miriam led me to a woman named Sunny.
Unlike Miriam, she felt somewhat cold.
Judging by her attitude and expression...
I did not seem to be very welcome.

Sunny explained, grumbling.
She said I had been swallowed by the Vacuum
and returned to reality after 15 years.
Everyone who returns gains special abilities,
and they are called "Psychics."

She added that I was one too.
It all made sense: the virtual-seeming space, Chloe's surprise...
Ignoring my daze, Sunny led me elsewhere.

Sunny took me to Benjamin,
commander of the Starry Forest League medical unit in Rocco Town.
The League manages the Psychics born from the Vacuum.
I could not hear everything,
but a serious problem was clearly occurring.
Afterward, Benjamin told me to take a job from Sunny,
whose expression was dark and gloomy.

Sunny opened her mouth, bewildered.
A child had been found in Control Zone 43,
so Miriam and some squad members went,
but a "Soul Junk" attack cut off their retreat.
The wolf from that time crossed my mind...
Sunny pleaded that only I could move.
I do not know why, but feeling a strong sense of mission,
as if guided by fate, I headed to the scene.
Unkown4: Clear out the Distribution Warehouse in Awakening.

Unkown3:
The site had been occupied by "Soul Junk."
I confirmed Miriam was alive and broke through the monsters. The child who protected me back then was there.
I barely got them to safety when a giant wolf burst through the wall, knocked Miriam aside and swallowed the child.
The child's words surfaced.
"You are me, and I am you..."
I have to save that child, whatever happens...

The pure white wolf spat out the child and vanished.
As if guided, I held out my hand, and the child reached out too.
The moment our hands touched, intense emotion flowed into me.
Countless people's feelings... Sadness, anger and envy tightened my heart,
joy, love and delight calmed my mind.
Through that whirlpool, I felt myself changing from human into something else.

Miriam told me.
The "SoulWorkers," who far surpass Psychics...
According to her, I was one of them too.
It was hard to comprehend,
but considering everything so far, it made sense.
Miriam also asked me to rescue
the people left behind at the scene.
I rescued a man named Eric,
and rescued everyone who had been trapped behind the iron door.

The people left behind said
there was a special wolf unlike the others.
It changed form every time, and in the worst case,
might be an "Awakened"...

It was no ordinary matter.
After rescuing them, I visited Miriam in Rocco Town.

Seeing her grave expression,
that ominous word crossed my mind.
What is an "Awakened"...?
Unkown4: Save the NED Employee in The Mission.

Unkown3:
My bad feeling was becoming reality.
Reports of a strange wolf in Control Zone 43
kept coming; Miriam believed it was
the giant wolf that attacked me.
Code name: "Wolf of Greed."
The most terrifying Awakened among the Soul Junk.
One can destroy an entire town...
Miriam told me to join Ryu, who had set out,
and defeat it.
Unkown4: Clear out the enemies at the mining site in [Wolf of Greed]

Unkown3:
Ryu had already confirmed the Wolf of Greed,
but realized his own abilities would not work, just like last time.
In his place, I faced the Wolf of Greed, "Cain."
Then a strange clown appeared.
He simply watched our battle,
and easily erased Cain, who had lost.
Then he disappeared.
Leaving word that he was inviting me to his stage...

The reunion with the clown came sooner than expected.
A letter arrived for me.
It said he had prepared a present
at R Square.
The sender's code name was "Blue Flame Clown."
He was a Rank S danger "Vessi" who had massacred many people,
including Psychics, in a past war.
Who on earth was he?
He looked no different from a human...

Ryu told me about the Vessi. They look and speak almost like humans,
but differ greatly in ability and thinking.
The League has fought them endlessly. Beings that appeared after the Vacuum...
"Soul Junk," and the "Vessi"... What is their purpose...?
I headed to "R Square," where the Blue Flame Clown invited me. Dolls filled with madness awaited.
Unkown4: Search the intrusion routes and plaza in [Puppet Legion]

Unkown3:
After somehow defeating the dolls and returning, new information had come in.
A giant doll loaded with a huge amount of explosives
was reportedly heading for Rocco Town.
The present... from that clown...
The Starry Forest League alone could not handle it...
Judging so, Benjamin ordered me to request
cooperation from the NED Company in Rocco Town.

Sean of the NED Company
stubbornly refused to cooperate with the Starry Forest League.
He wanted to leave Rocco Town as soon as possible,
and meant to use this incident as an excuse.
Then Eric of the NED Company, whom I had saved earlier,
handed me a small piece of paper.
If I gave this to Sean, there would be room to negotiate...
he said with a smile.

What Eric had written on the paper
was an exposé about embezzlement... in other words, a blackmail note.
Sean showed his anger, but allowed the use of
the unmanned helicopter at R Square.
However, its AI module had been removed,
so it needed to be set up again.
While Sean sets up the AI module,
I had to protect the helicopter from the dolls.
Unkown4: Survive from the Puppets' attack in [Impregnability]

Unkown3:
I somehow managed to hold the dolls back.
Sean handed over the AI module he had finished setting up
and left in a hurry.
The helicopter fitted with the AI module attacked
the one code-named "Big Puppet,"
but was destroyed in a single blow.
With the plan in ruins and the camp deflated,
Benjamin decided to use a last resort.

Benjamin's last resort was an operation called "The Shield."
A huge protective wall would be dropped around Big Puppet,
trapping it to self-destruct. Preparations were done, but someone had to
lure it into an open area... No one suited it better than me.
I activated the scanner sending my location to R Square,
and Eric came to see me before the battle.

Eric gave me a GPS and told me never to throw my life away. The decisive battle with Big Puppet began.
The walls of Operation The Shield closed in, but I could not escape.
I decided to make it self-destruct inside the wall.
Chloe tried to stop me, too late. As I hit its core, a roar and shockwave struck,
and warm power wrapped me. I woke among fragments... alive.

Back in Rocco Town, contrary to my expectations, I was scolded.
I have had enough of losing comrades to self-sacrifice...
That may be what they wanted to say.
I had almost betrayed their feelings...

Ryu and Benjamin encouraged me with vague words,
neither quite a scolding nor praise, as usual.
But, "No matter what choice you make, I believe in you"...
those words weighed heavily on me now.

While I fought Big Puppet at R Square,
another swarm of dolls attacked Rocco Town.
They looked completely different...
a second force, it was said.
All radio equipment, satellite scans included, was cut off,
so a search party went out.
They have not returned.
Benjamin asked me to investigate.
First, I had to enter the strange radio wave area
and track down the vanished party.
Unkown4: Defeat the second puppet unit in [Bad Premonition]

Unkown3:
The search party was not far away.
They had been hardened like wax figures
and could not move.
They looked like the ruins of Pompeii.
What on earth had happened to them...?
I hurried back to Benjamin.
Unkown4: Investigate the first [Wax Figure] in [Bad Premonition]

Unkown2: Strange Radio Waves That Bring Illness
Unkown3:
Analyzing the strange radio waves was Sunny's job now.
Her report said the waves seriously affect the body
and turn people into dolls.
She suggested the enemy inserted Temptation Stone fragments
into those turned into wax figures to control them.
Along with Sunny's report to Benjamin,
I was to inform Warren, who was making a fuss.

Hearing about the waves, Warren
asked us to hurry, since Rocco Town residents
also showed signs of turning into wax figures.
Benjamin judged it had to be resolved soon.
If the waves were the cause,
a device must be transmitting them,
and he ordered its destruction.
As I tried to destroy it,
a doll I had never seen appeared.
Huge, and it spoke...

Benjamin named the talking doll "Jack the King" and ordered its annihilation.
The tower could not be destroyed, so defeating Jack, the apparent command center, held the key.
Before I left, Miriam told me not to take my life lightly.
I plunged into battle with it in mind.
When I won, the Blue Flame Clown appeared and abandoned him. Why discard that doll so easily?

While I was on duty in the radio wave area,
the Blue Flame Clown was finally found
in a closed hospital.
Benjamin sent a search party,
but contact with all was lost.
It might be too late,
but we could not give up.
At the hospital I saw soldiers
near death from the dolls' attacks.
Unkown6: Speak to the [Dying Soldier] in [Silent Murder]

Unkown3:
The dolls had reportedly taken the soldiers' lives as if toying with them.
They barely survived,
but having had fear planted in them, they had lost their will to fight.
They would probably never set foot on a battlefield again.
I decided to return to Rocco Town for now.

Was this a prank to the Blue Flame Clown?
An area of the closed hospital
was blocked by a powerful magnetic field.
To disable it, I needed a badge held by his subordinate.
Like a test he prepared.
It might be a trap, but I had no choice...
I entered the next building
and got a tasteless badge.
Next: the Blue Flame Clown.
Unkown4: Obtain [Proof of Insanity] from [HIdeous Puppet] in [Badge of Sorrow]

Unkown3:
I used the badge to disable the magnetic field
and entered his area.
The Blue Flame Clown operated strange devices
with odd movements and attacked as if mocking me.
Just as the battle seemed to peak,
he suddenly began making senseless excuses
and simply vanished.
A capricious, unpredictable clown.
It felt like I was going insane...

I was wrong to think it had calmed.
The Blue Flame Clown planted bombs across Rocco Town
and invited me to his stage again.
I rushed to the hospital rooftop
for the final battle. I won after a desperate fight,
but the rooftop arena exploded.
I barely escaped by helicopter,
seeing the clown grin in the flames...
Unkown4: Save [Lonely Soldier] and defeat [Edgar] in [Mad Dance Under the Moon]

Unkown3:
The bombs planted in Rocco Town were all firecrackers.
What was the Blue Flame Clown doing this for...?
No one could understand what he was thinking.
After that, Benjamin reported my achievements
to the Starry Forest League leadership,
and I was ordered to the coastal city
"Candus City."
Before leaving, I said my farewells
to the people of Rocco Town.

The true enemy always creeps in from within.
Leaving those meaningful words,
Miriam handed me a small notebook.
She asked me to give it to
Lt. Colonel Aaron, commander of Candus City.
Wolves, dolls, and a clown...
What awaited me in this new world
was endless battle against unknown enemies...
What has the world... become...?

The man Miriam introduced
was not a human but a Vessi.
His name was Booker TV.
He is the boss of the odd-job group "Booker's Hand Gang."

He told me himself that he sold out his comrades to side with humans,
and I got a brief explanation of District 6 from him.

Booker TV's subordinate Billy
also told me everything I needed to know.

He was a bit odd... or rather, a Vessi...
Anyway, I headed to Candus City to report.

Lt. Colonel Aaron of Candus City
was a dignified gentleman.
I exchanged brief greetings and handed over the notebook,
but the tense situation left no time to rest.
Aaron introduced me to an operations soldier named Block,
central to advancing the operation.
She treated me like a child from the start
and even doubted I was a SoulWorker.

Block explained the mission. Candus City is isolated,
its road to Grace City blocked by Soul Junk,
so supplies barely arrive.
I was to defeat them and secure the coastal road.
She introduced the League's collaborators.
Victor, honorary Guild member, researches Soul Junk.
And Aaron's daughter Catherine,
a self-proclaimed Psychic who dreams of joining the League.

Aaron worried about Catherine.
Fathers are like that, I suppose.
Then he gave me the mission:
wipe out the Soul Junk on the coastal road
and secure the supply route.
Soul Junk fused with trash and building materials
lay in wait there.
When I returned, Aaron welcomed me,
astonished at a SoulWorker's power.
Unkown4: Eliminate the Soul Junk on the access routes and at the end of the street in [Blocked]

Unkown3:
With the supply route secured, we could request supplies from Grace City. Aaron suggested I see Victor.
He would have wanted any unusual Soul Junk on the road captured alive. Its code name was "Queen."
Victor could not go into detail and advised asking Block, muttering that her loose tongue might tell me.
She got angry, but told me, then said something had happened at Aaron's.

Aaron said many Soul Junk had again attacked a convoy on the coastal road,
including the "Asphalt Golem," which once wiped out a whole company alone.
Ignoring Catherine's interruptions,
he ordered me to defeat it and destroy
the tunnel so Soul Junk could never invade again.
Catherine followed me to prove herself. But what is Burning Red MKII...?

Catherine, having reached the tunnel entrance,
gave up going any further
and asked me to drive back the Soul Junk.
In the end, I defeated the Asphalt Golem
and blew up the tunnel alone, then returned to town.
Aaron praised my ability to carry out the mission,
but told me to call Catherine, who had come along without permission.
Unkown4: Activate [Bomb: Tunnel Explosion] inside of the tunnel in [Gray Rock]

Unkown3:
By Aaron's order, Victor was assigned
as Catherine's watcher.
I understood her wish to prove herself
and be of help to everyone,
but she could not beat Aaron's feelings as a father...
Does she not understand her father's feelings?
I have a feeling something terrible will happen soon.
Victor then told me Block was waiting,
looking angry.

Block said Henry, the town's man of power,
wanted to meet me.
She explained the NED Company's misdeeds.

Henry claimed I had become a hero
thanks to him and asked a favor.
The water supply had stopped,
so he wanted the waterway investigated.

Block argued, but had to fall silent before
the company that runs the city.
Aaron permitted it.

Aaron had long requested an investigation
of the underground waterway, always rejected.
He was suspicious of the sudden request.
Left unattended so long,
it might hold unpredictable problems.
I was told to prepare for combat.
Aaron and Block's ominous feeling proved right:
the waterway was overrun with
countless Soul Junk.
Unkown4: Search the underground waterway in [Monsters Lurking at Your Feet]

Unkown3:
Under Block's questioning, Henry opened up. The NED Company had secretly researched Vacuum Vein
for medicine and body enhancement, but failed.
In disposal, it flowed into the waterway. They promised responsibility...
Block judged they were hiding something and ordered an investigation.
She was right: company mercenaries and researchers were down there.

Ralph, a NED Company mercenary I met in the waterway,
had come with researchers on Henry's orders
to retrieve something there.
But a Soul Junk attack separated him from his companions,
leaving him stranded deep inside.
Barely able to protect himself,
he asked me to rescue the researchers left behind.
What could be worth deploying this many people...?
What was Henry hiding...?
Unkown4: Save the researchers in the ventilation room in [Black Nightmare]

Unkown3:
I tried to rescue the researchers, but it was already too late.
Most of the researchers had already become Soul Junk.
And another Soul Junk emerged from the darkness.
"Junk Knight."
It seemed to be a specimen modeled on a SoulWorker.
The "Junk Knight" displayed tremendous power
and then vanished into the darkness again.
Unkown4: Fight against the strange Soul Junk in [Black Nightmare]

Unkown3:
The Soul Junk "Junk Knight,"
born from a SoulWorker...

The only way to shake the NED Company at this point
is to investigate a Junk Knight sample
and reveal what they have made.

But can that really
put pressure on them?
Unkown4: Obtain [Junk Knight Sample] from [Junk Knight] in [Jet-Black Armor], then move to the outer passage

Unkown3:
On Aaron's orders, I gave the sample to Victor.
While Catherine and Block argued, the results came out.
Extracted with Vacuum Vein was "Anti-Soul,"
made by Dr. Hicks to counter SoulWorkers... and the NED Company was making it again.
Henry knew yet stayed brazen. Even when Block asked, he kept silent.
I had to go back, and Ralph approached me.

Seeing Block and Henry argue, Ralph sensed something had happened. A NED Company transport aircraft
had crashed at a mansion near Candus City...
Its information manipulation made Ralph suspicious. Block ordered the mansion investigated.
I found the wreckage, an empty giant capsule, and a familiar ribbon: Catherine's.
Unkown4: Find the traces of the [NED Company] and then defeat [Dark Worm] in [Lightless Mansion]

Unkown3:
While I prepared to investigate the Junk Knight, Victor
reported Catherine missing,
but it was already too late.

Ralph said she had entered that mansion.
I rescued her,
but a giant spider-type Soul Junk
carried her off again.

Aaron launched a large-scale search.
Unkown4: Speak to [Ralph] in [Candus City] and then defeat [Duke Spider] in [The Search]

Unkown3:
Aaron judged the NED Company had information
on the unusual Soul Junk and told me to get it from Henry.
Block struck the feigning Henry
and made him reveal the queen spider.
Code name: "Archness."
I found its lair and rescued Catherine,
but the Vacuum Vein had taken her.
Unkown4: After speaking with [Henry] in [Candus City], defeat [Archness], who carried off [Catherine] in [Beautiful Predator]

Unkown3:
Catherine's condition was critical.
Eroded by the Vacuum Vein,
she was already turning into a Soul Junk.
Aaron was heartbroken at his daughter's suffering,
and Victor was consumed by guilt.
And Catherine did her best to act as usual.
Was there no way to bring Catherine back?

Catherine grew weaker as time passed.
While I was feeling frustrated at being unable to do anything,
Block took me to Henry.

Henry tried to drive her away,
but Block, hiding firm resolve, began to speak.

"I have a favor to ask."

In exchange for destroying the documents on
the NED Company's misdeeds,
Block got antidote information from Henry.
It was at N-102.
But N-102 was a Soul Junk den...
I searched N-102 but found nothing.
Back, Block irritably asked where Victor was.
He was nowhere to be seen.
Unkown4: After destroying the [Eerie Cocoon] in [Bottom of the Abyss], investigate the [Giant Capsule] in the central laboratory

Unkown3:
Consumed by guilt over Catherine,
Victor had gone alone to the laboratory
to search for the antidote.
I hurried after him, but he had already
been trapped in a cocoon by the Soul Junk
and was on the verge of becoming one.
Unkown4: Find a way to free [Victor] in [Egg of Tragedy].

Unkown3:
Victor had not only found the antidote,
but learned new information inside the cocoon.
He heard a mysterious voice there.
A voice so clear and sweet it captivated him...
Victor thought this voice was a phenomenon
that accompanies turning into a Soul Junk.
We had to have Henry confirm this antidote soon.
Unkown4: Return to [Candus City] and speak to [Victor].

Unkown3:
Henry confirmed the antidote was genuine.
But we needed mucus from the Beholder,
the cause of the Soul Junk den.

The NED Company had planned to control the Beholder
and monopolize the antidote,
but that no longer mattered.

While getting the mucus,
Henry also ordered me to activate the laboratory's self-destruct device.

I headed to the laboratory again to get the Beholder's mucus
and activate the self-destruct device.
I defeated the Beholder, got the mucus,
and activated the device.
The laboratory exploded... ending the NED Company's
research in Candus City.
That brought me a little relief.
All that remained was Catherine's treatment.
Unkown4: Obtain the [Mad Beholder's Slime] from [Mad Beholder] in [Red Evil Eye]

Unkown3:
Preparing the antidote was only a matter of mixing.
Henry said he wanted no further involvement.
When Victor and I went to deliver the antidote to Catherine,
she was troubling everyone around her as usual.
She resisted fiercely when we tried to inject the antidote,
but calmed down at last when Aaron arrived.
Unkown4: Speak to [Henry] in [Candus City] and check [Catherine].

Unkown3:
Victor told Aaron what happened in the cocoon.
I was asked to investigate Soul Junk transformations
in Rocco Town. There Sunny introduced me to Warren.
A NED Company worker had gone missing
in an invasion and returned eroded. He kept hearing a voice; when
it vanished, he became a Soul Junk. Back in Candus City, Block called to me, tense.
Unkown4: Obtain information from [Sunny] and [Warren] in [Rocco Town].

Unkown3:
Block explained that a huge number of Soul Junk
were invading outside town,
and with NED Company transport support
they planned to evacuate the residents.
But the shelter's opening device was not working
and had to be operated manually.
I got the device running and returned,
and this time Aaron was waiting for me.

Hearing about Rocco Town, Aaron
told me to inform Victor too.
Victor worried about Catherine.
With no treatment, he considered asking
the ST Lab unit in Grace City
to keep her asleep.
Then I went to the shelter with Aaron.
Unkown4:
After speaking with [Victor] in [Candus City],
clear out the enemies inside the transport aircraft in [Gathering Shadows]

Unkown3:
Victor asked Catherine whether she could hear that voice.
But he could not bring himself
to tell the truth to her, who answered honestly.
He had no choice but to lie and hurry Aaron.
Anyway, there was no time...
We had to head to Grace City quickly...

Preparations for the residents' and Catherine's escape were complete,
and just as Aaron was about to board,
a Soul Junk attack wounded him.
Even as he was helped aboard,
Aaron kept worrying about his daughter.
Why are there so many Soul Junk...?
Is it because of Catherine, as Block said...?
Unkown4: Team up with [Aaron] in [Sky of Lament].
Unkown6: Move to the interior of the transport airship in [Sky of Lament] with [Aaron].

Unkown3:
We finally boarded the transport aircraft,
but it was not safe there either.
Not only the few that had boarded on the ground,
but flying Soul Junk had invaded the interior.
The Dignity Snatcher from the mansion appeared again
and persistently targeted Catherine, but I somehow drove it off.
Why do Soul Junk keep coming for her...?
Unkown4: Search for traces of [Catherine] in [Sky of Lament].

Unkown3:
The enemy had given up nothing.
As Catherine happily said she could no longer hear the voice...
The Dignity Snatcher absorbed her
and became the Awakened "Amaryllis."
Power beyond any Soul Junk.
I cannot stop Amaryllis... Catherine!
Then that child appeared again,
and we swore an oath for new power.
To grant her rest...
Unkown6: Check on [Aaron]'s condition on the top roof in [Sky of Lament]

Unkown3:
The antidote Henry spoke of was not genuine.
It was a substance that induced turning into a Soul Junk,
made from the Beholder's DNA.
When Aaron went to see him after learning of the trick,
the place was deserted.
According to Ralph, a NED Company mercenary,
Henry had left on his private aircraft.
We had no choice but to leave.

The wounded Aaron asked me to track down Henry.
Suppressing unbearable anger, I headed for my destination.
The city of blessings, "Grace City."
There is only one thing to do here...
I will never forgive Henry...!

What awaited me after waking from a long sleep
was an ominous sky and a city like a ruin.
Where on earth was this... Before I could sort out my feelings,
a young child suddenly appeared before me
and told me to follow.
Confused, I decided to follow,
feeling that I had seen this somewhere before...

Following the child, I was attacked by a pack of black wolves.
A weapon appeared out of nowhere...
After somehow breaking through, I heard voices in the distance.
I climbed into their truck as I was told.
The moment a giant wolf closing in bared its fangs,
time stopped.
A feeling as if something was leaving my body...
And then I lost consciousness.

When I came to, I was in a hospital room.
The woman who had saved me stood before me.
The woman, who called herself Miriam,
told me about this "world" as we walked.
A world changed beyond recognition, Psychics,
and the Starry Forest League...
My head was starting to ache...

A man named Benjamin told me to take a test.
It was close to a threat,
but it seemed I had no choice but to comply for now.
With heavy steps, I headed into [Steel Grave],
the test area.
From the communicator came the voice of
a new operator, "Chloe."
Anyway, the test began as I was told.

I cleared the test easily.
A physical ability test and an unexpected combat ability test.
I never thought the training robots would be so fragile...
Looking around, it did not feel like the real world.
Was this some kind of game?
But Chloe's reaction was strange...
Had something unexpected happened?

My tension gradually began to ease.
Following the instructions of operator "Chloe,"
I simply moved forward.

That was Soul Barrier. Chloe explained to me that it is a special magnetic field.
The power within me allowed me to break through this shield and destroy it.
I was astounded. Slowly I began to ask myself whether we were still within reality or not.

After I destroyed all the training robots,
a giant "Training Master" robot appeared.
From its size to its power, it seemed in a different league.
If it existed in reality, people would be crushed...
But I easily destroyed even this giant.
Chloe seemed shocked by the unexpected turn.
Could all of this be my real power...?
If so, where did I get such power...?

The test ended.
My power exceeded the facility's tolerance,
so all the machines inside apparently broke.
Since recovery would take time,
I was told to move to a nearby town called Rocco Town.

Tracking Henry, I reached
Grace City, the City of Blessings.
Peaceful, unlike any city I had seen.
Toru, the temporary commander, said that
the League and the NED Company
publicly cooperate,
so he could not officially help track Henry,
but would help unofficially.
Find evidence of their misdeeds, he said.
Among the members I greeted, a strange man.

The man's name was Kane Barrel... a SoulWorker.
There were once so many SoulWorkers that
at least one could be assigned to each company,
but most never came back after a certain incident.
He did not explain in detail...
I greeted Jeremy, who called himself my passionate fan,
and Emilito of the operations support unit,
then returned to Toru.

The Vessi... like Edgar, the Blue Flame Clown,
beings from another world with human speech and appearance.
Fighting the Vessi is unavoidable on this mission.
On Toru's instructions that I should fight the Vessi early,
I headed to the highway.
The Vessi currently near Grace City
were the Rapid Flame, who seek great power.

Unkown3:
Seeing me anxious about tracking Henry, Toru
told me to go cool my head.

When I spoke with Sedurin, chief doctor of the Starry Forest League's
weapons development department, ST Lab, I was introduced to
Neb, a mysterious billionaire who provides huge funds to the Guild.

Neb was physically impaired by burns covering their whole body.
Roy of the Starry Forest League was always at Neb's side,
caring for them and helping with rehabilitation.
I felt uneasy about the strange air between the two...

Senia suddenly said Henry's whereabouts had been found.
Having fled Candus City, Henry was
isolated in a car on the highway.
It was a mystery why his car was on the highway
held by the Vessi... but that did not matter.
If I could catch Henry, I would go anywhere.
...Even if it was a trap.

The car was empty, but a briefcase on the ground
held a NED Company USB drive with information on Catherine... Amaryllis. It was not decisive evidence alone.
The USB held locked data, so we waited for a hacker. Meanwhile I was to defeat Scar,
the Rapid Flame assault leader. Afterward, good news:
a company device would unlock it. I asked Emilito for help.

Laufer, the NED Company's chief secretary
and Emilito's close friend, proposed a deal.
If I found Henry,
he would provide a device to unlock the USB.
Henry should be in the NED Company's office,
but it was occupied by the Rapid Flame ambush unit.
I defeated them and tried to go upstairs,
but the elevator did not work because of a power shortage.

The NED Company's office apparently could
force-activate the emergency main power.
Manually activating the four sub-generators
would restore main power temporarily
and make the elevator usable.
The security key for the security box,
which unlocks the USB,
was also somewhere in the building.
I activated the power, got the key, and reported.

All that remained was to find Henry on the top floor
and unlock the USB with the security box.
Emilito reported Laufer's suspicious behavior to Toru and Senia.
Warned of a trap, Senia said to smash it.
He also reported Rapid Flame ambush leader "Poison"
was at the NED Company.
Senia ordered me to unlock the USB, then defeat Poison.
Ask Kane Barrel.

Kane Barrel said our weapons and styles differ,
so his advice was useless.
With NBRF, the NED Company's elite mercenaries,
I connected the USB to the security box.
I fought Poison, the Rapid Flame ambush leader,
but she withdrew, meaningfully saying
the appointed time had come.

I connected the USB, but instead of unlocking it,
all the data was transferred to Laufer.
Feeling deceived, I decided to trust Laufer's word
that he would share the analysis results.
Ignoring Emilito's worry, Jeremy
insisted Laufer would never betray him.
At Jeremy's suggestion, I asked Sora
about the two's relationship.

Sora told me about Emilito and Laufer.
Friends since childhood, they parted over differing values...
Like Jeremy, Sora said Laufer would never betray Emilito.
I asked Laufer again, and Henry's part in
the Amaryllis project came to light. The NED Company
would capture him too, and support Operation Wolf Cry.
Senia snorted at the news.

Senia disliked the NED Company wagging its tail when things turn bad,
but was delighted by support for Wolf Cry,
once impossible due to its enormous budget.
I had contributed greatly to resuming it,
so I was assigned as a main force.
The keys were the sonic missile F-Aria
and a special tank, the Hill Breaker.
I greeted Heavy Gears, the unit operating them.

Operation Wolf Cry began, but the route for
the special tank Hill Breaker was apparently blocked.
I blasted the road debris blocking the route
and cleared the way.

Kane Barrel was also assigned to the operation,
and I went on a mission with another SoulWorker for the first time.
The moment the Hill Breaker secured its firing position,
the anti-Garura sonic missile F-Aria shook the sky.

The operation was a great success. We shot down more than eight-tenths of the Garura
and even dragged Queen Garura, the beloved bird
of assault squad leader Falcon, down to the ground.
After Kane Barrel left,
I fought Queen Garura and forced it to retreat.

It is well known that Falcon, the Rapid Flame assault squad leader,
cherishes Queen Garura.
Senia was sure the enraged Falcon would show himself.
As expected, Falcon reportedly appeared on the Highway 2.
All that was left was to crush him by force.
The folly of not knowing who the true enemy is will be your undoing...
Falcon's last words stayed in my ears.

With all the opposing forces driven off, I took a brief rest.
News of defeating the assault, ambush and storm squad leaders
had already spread throughout Grace City.
Hearing Jeremy's praise, Emilito's thanks,
and Roy's sarcasm, I enjoyed a good rest.

In Dave Town, a town near Grace City,
nearly 300 residents vanished in an instant.
A large-scale search led by Kane Barrel is underway,
but so far there is no result.
Senia told me to look for some evidence,
so I headed to Dave Town.
All that greeted me were clothes scattered on the ground
and the Rapid Flame, eyes glinting in the rain.

The clothes brought back from Dave Town
were ordinary clothes, nothing out of the ordinary.
When Sora examined them, skin was stuck to the inside.
Sensing it was no ordinary matter, Sora
asked Sedurin for a detailed analysis.

What clung to the clothes was human skin.
Sedurin guessed the excess Soul Energy
injected into their bodies had exploded
and evaporated them.
So we placed Spirit Pathfinders,
which measure Soul Energy fluctuation, in various places.
Then I met a Rapid Flame machine
that evaporates humans and absorbs their Soul Energy.
Its code name was "Tempest."

Sedurin examined Tempest's parts and said
she had seen them at the NED Company's technical conference.
Suspecting an alliance with the Rapid Flame,
Senia pressed Laufer.
He resented being called a traitor,
but his face stiffened at the part Senia showed.
That Drain Claw used NED Company technology,
and Henry was in charge.
Henry's betrayal was certain.

I entered the place where the Soul Energy
of all of Dave Town's residents was thought to have been collected.

Waiting there was Poison, the Green Storm Witch.
Acting as if stalling for time for some reason, Poison
suddenly vanished in the middle of the battle.

Then Scar, the storm squad leader
I had fought earlier on the highway, stood in my way.

Scar, now fully fused with Soul Energy,
was in a different league from before.
The energy Tempest had collected had become his power.
But Scar, having cast aside his pride, began to doubt his own strength,
and that led to his defeat.
A pitiful Vessi who had lost his desire...
Scar turned to ash and vanished.

Never lose heart.
This advice from Kane Barrel bonded with Scar's appearance and controlled my thoughts.

Laufer's words surprised us.
The NED Company had found the Rapid Flame's base
and was preparing to strike...
It aimed to overwhelm the Starry Forest League
and raise doubts about the Guild's existence.
He hoped the League would act first.
Toru decided to gather all forces of Rocco Town and Candus City
and strike at once.
I went to Rocco Town for support.

Rocco Town had no strength to spare after fighting Edgar's remnants,
and Candus City was clearing Soul Junk.
The grim atmosphere was so tense
I could not even speak to Aaron and Victor.
Unable to request support, I returned to Grace City.
Toru understood and decided to gather
all of Grace City's forces to strike the Rapid Flame base.

The night ambush operation seemed to be going well,
but the Rapid Flame assassination squad lay in wait,
and the vanguard suffered a crushing defeat, wiped out.
Because of Laufer's false information,
Grace City's forces suffered fatal losses.
Enraged, I tried to confront him,
but he had already vanished from Grace City.

The Vessi heat signature detected at the place thought to be
the Rapid Flame's base
was information manipulated by the NED Company
by hacking the Starry Forest League's satellite.
In this desperate situation, there were people left behind at the rendezvous point.
I had to save them...

Emilito and Jeremy are alive...
Hearing that, I rushed to the rendezvous point, but what awaited me was
cold soldiers and Emilito lying fallen,
and Jeremy beside him, sunk in despair.
Phantom, the Rapid Flame's assassination squad leader.
Having taken many lives, he said
that this war had been wrong from the start...

Jeremy hurled abuse at me.
To him, Emilito and I were heroes.
But one could do nothing,
and the other lost his life far too easily.
Having faced a terrible reality, Jeremy
probably had no choice but to direct his resentment at someone.
Just then, I was summoned by Senia.
Her words that she had found the NED Company's secret base
were a wake-up call.

Tracing back the hacked satellite,
a tactical name, Area 9, was listed.

During the search, I encountered NED Company mercenaries.
And at the edge of the road, on a huge, tightly shut iron gate,
the NED Company logo was clearly visible.

We tried various methods to scan the inside of
the NED Company's secret base,
but jamming made scanning impossible.
So we decided to plant an EMP bomb inside
to disable the machine generating the jamming signal.
The operation succeeded, and we could scan the interior facilities.
The time for revenge is near...

Scanning the inside of the base,
we caught several life signs.

Following the Near SoulWorker signals with Kane Barrel, I reached "Ruin Fortress," once the NED Company's military fortress. Steel and cold air made it look silent; nobody was there.
League members had arrived: commander "Martin," communications officer "Amanda" and energy specialist "Sara." A hastily assembled team, we could not expect teamwork.
Kane Barrel sighed.

Though hastily assembled, each member was capable, and we began grasping the facility. The biggest problem: power control was locked.
Amanda guessed an AI held it.
Without control we could not search, so we entered to confirm the AI, and found the Near SoulWorkers' shuttle empty. Next: secure that AI... "Lucy." Fearing she saw us as enemies, I moved on.
Unkown4: Ask about the current whereabouts of [Near SoulWorker]

Unkown3:
Sara doubted a self-aware AI ran on one headset; many sub AI cores must support the main core.
We could not hack Lucy, who was hostile, so we planned to destroy the sub AI cores, then hack her.
It was dangerous, and Kane Barrel was called back to Grace City.
I destroyed the cores and waited for hacking, but nobody at camp could hack. As I turned back, a young boy appeared.

The boy was a refugee left behind by an incident at Ruin Fortress. His name was "Abel." His frightened, anxious state was painful to see, so I hurriedly took him back to the camp.
At the camp, Martin, who suspected Abel, and Amanda, who criticized him for it, argued, but in the end Amanda would be the one to ask Abel what had happened.

Abel was the son of a researcher who worked on Ruin Fortress. His family lived there, but met a sudden accident, probably why nobody was here. He survived in a secret room on emergency rations and called out when he sensed people.
Abel said Lucy was just an AI acting in place of people; delete her and control would pass to us.
I formatted Lucy and gained control, but another problem arose.

We had control, but not enough power. We could do little beyond opening doors.
Sara insisted a fortress should never depend on external power. Abel agreed.
It runs on an autonomous source, the Buster Core, drawing from three Slave Cores. With all running, power could be used freely.
Following Abel, I ran the Slave Cores, and power flowed normally.

But the Slave Core was recognized as activated by an "unrecognized one," and the other two, seeing it as an "enemy," cut off its power.
Sara decided to destroy both physically, as with Lucy. Power would drop by more than half, but we could not make them accept an "ally." We needed to start the search soon.
Returning, I sensed commotion. Abel had suddenly disappeared.

Abel's signal was confirmed deep in the Buster Core. How and when he got there was a mystery, but securing him came first.
During the search, Chloe seemed off. When I pressed her, Abel's face suddenly appeared on the operator display, and Abel emerged from the Buster Core.
He declared himself a Near SoulWorker.
Unkown6: Save [Abel] in [Spear That Calls the Storm]

Unkown3:
Abel thanked us in a way that hardly counted, saying our help made his work smooth, and vanished. Tracking him deep in the Buster Core, I found him starting to absorb its energy. Another Near SoulWorker, "Noah," blocked me.
The battle dragged on; Abel absorbed all the energy and fled with Noah.
Back at camp, everyone looked unsettled.

Abel had absorbed most of the Buster Core's energy, so the control plan went awry. We started the Near SoulWorker search in earnest with minimal control, pursuing Abel.
Tracking the Buster Core's unique wavelength, we found a reading underground that seemed to lure us.
Underground was a shuttle route, but deep inside a huge door blocked the way. I returned to camp.

With the gate impassable, I took another shuttle route. During dull exploration, I met NED Company soldiers.
After a small fight, their leader fled, but a sickly old man stood still. He showed no alarm, as if he had been waiting.
Unkown6: Speak to [Suspicious old man] in [The Trail].

Unkown3:
The old man who came back with me was "Hicks," a NED Company doctor, the foremost authority in Cloudream on bioengineering.
He clearly approached the League for a reason, but said nothing. I gave up and re-entered the shuttle route.
At the huge iron door, I met another Near SoulWorker, "Enoch."
Like Noah, he held back, hinting at a trump card. We confirmed Buster Core energy beyond.

Behind the iron door was a massive arsenal, including weapons banned by convention. It was evidence the NED Company had prepared for war against the SFL from the start.
Amanda reported the energy reaction was stationary.
Abel must have halted with Buster Core energy to prepare something else.
The coordinates of the energy reaction pointed to the depths of the Armory It was unclear what was waiting for me and just what plan Abel was following, yet I could not just stand idly by.

Breaking through the unmanned robots' attacks, I reached the deepest part of the armory, where a huge robot, completed only in its upper half, awaited.
After I defeated the giant robot Abel was piloting, Abel left meaningful words and fled with the robot's core. "I can finally meet you..."
Unkown4: Break through the [Depths of the Armory]

Unkown3:
Hicks clearly knew Abel's purpose but stayed silent. Martin gave up and changed the mission from searching for the Near SoulWorkers to defeating them. Startled, Hicks asked us to wait.
He said Abel was surely heading to the Deep Core, Ruin Fortress's true power source, and led us there.
The Deep Core lay beneath the fortress like a bottomless ant lion pit.

Hicks explained that Abel absorbed the Buster Core's power to activate the Deus Ex Machina, and challenged us because he needed the Soul Energy only SoulWorkers have.
The machine absorbs a SoulWorker's unique energy; the battle had gathered ours.
Abel meant to activate the Deep Core with it. An artificial SoulWorker, he could imitate power but not unique energy.

Noah waited at the Deep Core. Unlike last time, she challenged me with the Near SoulWorkers' true power, "Exceed."
I overcame her overwhelming power, but the Deep Core was already active.
As silence fell, a strong vibration shook all of Ruin Fortress.
Amanda said it was an engine starting up... but what was happening?

The excavator [Dig Monster] caused the tremor. Seven of them built Ruin Fortress in a month. Abel wanted to use it to wake the Near SoulWorker prototype [Sion].
Sion, the strongest Near SoulWorker, had wiped out all life in Ruin Fortress. If she woke, it would be the end.
Unbelievable, but the NED Company's escape was proof.
To stop her, the Dig Monster had to be stopped.

The Dig Monster's output kept rising, with no known limit.
I reached where it kept digging, but it was too late. Sion appeared on the surface with a light that pierced the heavens.
Abel escaped at once with her.
Fortunately, Sion was not yet in a normal state after being sealed. It was not completely too late...

In the military laboratory where I went to secure Sion, Enoch requested contact. She said Abel and Sion were with her and would end everything.
I rushed to her signal, but it was a lie. Abel and Sion had already evacuated, and Enoch had used Exceed to buy time.
My impatience grew, as did the others'.

Abel's and Sion's signals were at a huge construction facility.
Hicks spoke. Project "Ark" was the NED Company's secret project to create SoulWorkers artificially.
Its product, the prototype Near SoulWorker Sion, had her mind destroyed by inhumane experiments, slaughtered everyone in Ruin Fortress and was sealed.
Hicks wished those ordinary children ordinary lives.

Back at camp, Hicks had disappeared. Amanda said he went to the Ark Ship site to atone to the children. She had helped him, knowing he would die.
She wanted the experimenter punished; Martin rebuked her.
On the way, I found Hicks with Jake of the NED Company, deeply wounded by Jake's bullet. I suppressed them, but...
He was beyond saving, and closed his eyes.

The goal was clear: seal Sion and let the remaining Near SoulWorkers live ordinary lives, as Hicks asked. I headed to the Ark Ship.
I defeated Abel and tried to secure Sion, but his near-scream woke her. Overwhelming power. I could not even approach. As I lost consciousness, golden light wrapped around us. After that, nothing is clear.
I heard a voice I felt I knew...

The fierce battle left only emptiness. The Near SoulWorkers, including Sion, vanished.
The energy of Sion's fight with the woman in golden armor, "Rosca," activated the Anomalous Vacuum, and the world fell into confusion. We and the survey team went to investigate a giant Anomalous Vacuum that could be freely entered and exited.
Unkown4: Speak to [Amanda] and [Sarah] in the [Ruin Fortress] and unearth the truth.

Unkown3:
We carefully entered the alternate Vacuum. Devastation stretched under a Sinister sky. Nothing moved. Vacuum had drained the last life from the city.
The SFL commander introduced me to one who returned from the dead five years ago: Tenebris, the first of all SoulWorkers. The legend began with him.

The words of the man called Tenebris were hard to understand, and when I brushed him off by saying I remembered nothing, he fell silent with a suspicious look. The greetings we exchanged seemed to carry too much distrust to be called a welcome.

The first thing we came across in Casual Raid were the Vessi from Rapid Flame Assault Squad, who we'd already encountered in Grace City. I thought the Void had sucked them in just as it had those Helpless people before. But Tenebris saw things very differently.

The "Spirit Pathfinder" set up to find survivors could not sense Soul Energy. Amanda, in communications, heard a strange voice.
Before the SoulWorker who fought the Rapid Flame remnants stood "Tempest," who had killed many. They plotted something with that machine, which draws in energy from the air, but the SoulWorker shattered it.
Unkown4: Speak to [Amanda] and [Tenebris], then defeat the Vessi.

Unkown3: With the Rapid Flame driven back, the camp in the Anomalous Vacuum could calm down. The medical unit Fortune, prepared in Rocco Town, could be sent in, and I spoke with Miriam, who came with it. She seemed different, as if hiding something about "Tenebris."

With the Vessi withdrawn from the camp, the survey team's investigation, which had been hard to carry out until then, could proceed, and as a result an unidentified space was confirmed.
What the SoulWorker saw there was a cityscape exactly like Rocco Town, and illusions of former enemies.

When I told Tenebris what I had seen, he said none of this was surprising in the Vacuum, "the territory of Desire Energy." Its overwhelming force fulfills desires beyond common sense.
Martin doubted how "Soul Energy, which Desire Energy should neutralize, can still be used," but Tenebris cut in as if dodging.
Miriam kept worrying about him, but it would take time to speak.

What appeared in the still-active illusion zone was the illusion of Edgar the Clown. Recalling the anger from when I first fought him, the SoulWorker headed into the illusion zone to completely erase an illusion they never wanted to see again. There, someone's... voice reached my ears, one I should never have heard, yet somehow familiar.

Tenebris said that it was a "shadow," a "form from the past." He also told me to leave this place before something irreversible happened.
It was a shock, since I had thought I could manage by ignoring it. Thinking alone was no use, so I decided to consult Miriam.

Miriam told me that whatever kind of person I was in the past, the me who has overcome so many hardships is an entirely different person now. Calming my unsettled feelings, I faced the other illusions.

The more I investigated, the deeper my suspicions grew. While the SoulWorker was confused, an urgent call came from Toru.
An incident inside the Vacuum: Psychics were disappearing at Grasscover Camp.
The investigation of Roy was unfinished, but we could not let the damage grow.
The SoulWorker headed there with Kane Barrel, who had joined up.

Chasing the vanished Psychics, I wandered into a place like a park.
There lay Psychics in a pitiful state, attacked by violent animals and plants.
As I pushed forward, shaking off the cruel sight, Amanda's manner during the communication suddenly...

In Grasscover Camp, E.S.P Corps were affected by similar symptoms to those in the park.
Somehow, Amanda recovered thanks to Martin's Help and Miriam thanks to Tenebris.
Alarmed by these events, we hurried back to the park to seek the missing people as quickly as possible.

The condition of the Psychics found alive in the park was serious.
Some fainted while shouting "Lord Vacuum," some resisted...
What on earth was happening?

Everyone was safe. Martin suggested we return and observe. Once the whole E.S.P Corps banded together, we would capture the whole pack.
He was right. Chasing them individually was impossible.
Martin told the [Tragedy of the Night Sky]:
a SoulWorker created Hell on Earth five years ago. It was Tenebris, slurping coffee over there.

Unkown3:
With all preparations for the operation complete, the SoulWorker and Kane Barrel went to the park again.
They had been confirming where the missing people were heading and tracking them, but because Kane Barrel was unwell, they returned to camp once.

Unkown3:
We had saved the Psychics to some extent, but no one knew what danger lay ahead.
On headquarters' orders, support personnel gradually withdrew from the Vacuum, and the situation worsened.
Even so, the SoulWorker proposed staying to fight.
Martin, Amanda, Miriam, Sedurin and Kane Barrel promised to support.

Unkown3:
Chasing the missing people, we arrived at an old factory.
There were many monsters... and Starry Forest League soldiers who had turned into zombie-like creatures.

The missing Psychics attack in zombie-like form.
Sedurin, who examined a sample, explained that they all suffer from Desire Energy poisoning and that the other missing people would eventually end up like this too.
With no way to restore them now... killing them so they would not suffer was the only option.

Unkown3:
Tenebris seemed to have an idea who the mastermind was.
His name was Kent. Probably the same person as Roy.
He is wicked and cunning, and I was warned to be careful.

Unkown3:
Deep inside the factory, Roy released a monster he called the "finished product."

Unkown3:
The message's author was "Lord." When I mentioned the seemingly familiar name to Martin and Tenebris, they told me about Lord.
The man who founded the Starry Forest League 13 years ago and was assassinated that same year...
Why was such a person now Roy's plaything?

Roy was laughing, praising us for defeating the finished product.
As a reward for the fight, he released a few hostages and vanished from the spot.

An incident that ended with nothing resolved.
The missing people who vanished might rise in revolt from now on.
The SoulWorker gave up investigating the Vacuum and returned to Grace City.

Grace City had to mourn a Clear E.S.P Corps. To say nothing of the security of the city.
In comparison, Candus City had taken little damage and was promptly asked for Help. Beneris, another SoulWorker, and I were sent to fetch Help.
We had scarcely reached Candus City when two more pieces of the puzzle fell into place: Beneris and... Henry!

Aaron was lost the moment Henry's name dropped. He inched toward breaking point, but kept listening to Beneris.
Henry had hidden in Dipluce, the port city steeped in legend, hoping to win the Soul Junk queen over to wipe out humanity.
Brooke warned of the horror awaiting there. But Aaron would not be dissuaded from pursuing Henry. So I had no other choice.

The Dipluce port city I arrived at had already been occupied by Soul Junk and was like a ruin.
Having barely established ourselves across the sea from the Sinkhole, we urgently needed to build a camp. For that, based on Block's opinion, we had to take the highest place in this area, the building rooftops.

Returning after completing the first line of defense, Aaron was angry at a soldier.
The soldier wanted a slightly safer assignment, but Aaron said that if he started accepting each person's circumstances and requests, "no one would stay in a hell like this."
Here, people were treated as soldiers, and soldiers as tools.

Aaron had a pendant with Catherine's photo. I asked to see it, but his cold attitude showed he had changed.
Hearing Aaron had shot a soldier, I wondered why I was fighting here, but hearing Block had saved the soldier, I carved the purpose of helping people into my heart again.

The next mission was to defeat a giant Soul Junk moving between buildings. There was no fear of this place being endangered or attacked, but Aaron forced me onto the battlefield to collect combat data.
I again wondered whether fighting for such a reason had any meaning, but it seemed I no longer had room even for such worries.
Unkown4: Clear [Mission: Soul Junk Elimination] in [Sky Walker].

Unkown3: With the camp construction complete, we needed to begin a full investigation beneath the Sinkhole. But jumping down into a place of unknown depth was impossible. To arrange equipment capable of descending the Sinkhole, I headed to Toru at Ruin Fortress.

In the Ruin Fortress, Toru asserted that he had seen Near SoulWorkers there. He was so sure about it that he didn't even crack any jokes. But Martin didn't want to know.
What on earth was going on here? My mission was pressing, however, and so I made my way back to Dipluce Horizon just as artfully as I had before.

The fleet that set out to carry the dropship had to pass through waters thick with Soul Junk.
Before any major problem could occur, I too headed to the fleet and began protecting the ships.

Block was talking with a soldier named Gruwell, whom she had earlier saved from a firing squad.
Gruwell was filled with disgust and hatred toward Aaron, but Block was restraining him, so he quietly endured.
Even in this situation, Victor said strange things such as using people's corpses and asked to be understood... but it was hard for me to understand him.

Aaron's condition had worsened. He shouted at Block because his private time was being disturbed and gave a bad impression to those around him.
All that remained was anxiety about whether the camp could be maintained like this.

When the 2nd dropship transport work ended and the dropship installation began,
I heard the sound of someone quietly moving somewhere.
Unkown4: Clear [Rescue Mission: The 2nd Fleet] in [Transport Fleet].

Unkown3: After the dropship installation work began, the camp's atmosphere changed a little, but Aaron still burned with vengeance. The sight of him forcing people into the dropship installation work like tools gave a bad impression.

When soldiers' discontent and exhaustion from forced camp construction and non-stop installation overflowed, some stole a ship and deserted.
Aaron and Beneris decided to ignore the dropship installation and turn a blind eye, with no time to chase them... but things changed when Aaron's pendant disappeared.

Realizing the pendant had been stolen, Aaron reversed his decision to turn a blind eye and chose to attack the one who had escaped.
I was to head there too...

1. The Soul Junk Queen is Lunar Nox.

I decided to investigate further the laboratory, which held more materials than expected.

Henry and Neb, who are chasing the Queen. I caught up with them, but had no choice but to give up fighting Neb, who stood in our way.

The method Block came up with to counter Neb, who stood in our way, was to use the cathedral's secret passage.
This time, Beneris would also go down with us to deal with the situation.
The one I met when descending with Beneris was Henry. Henry was captured by a parasitic Soul Junk and met his end.
After Being failed to capture the Queen, we have to satisfied with the result of resting Henry in peace.
Toru welcomed the SoulWorker who returned to Grace City. In Grace City, commanders from all regions had gathered and a meeting was about to be held for the next war.

Before the war, our mission is to defeat the rest of Vacuum Fanatics.
Eliminating the root of evil before we leave [Dipluce Horizon].

2nd Generation SoulWorkers; they're manmade SoulWorkers that the East has been training for 10 years. Each one of them follows someone they call [Godmother] and drive Energy through devotion to Starry Forest League and love for their individual [Godmothers].
I, [Ain], who witnessed the 2nd Generation waking up in the break room, intend to judge them objectively as their supervisor.
The 2nd Generation's combat test began. Not many will remain to the end.

Unkown3:

Some of them seem to conduct business illegally, but it should not be a big problem for supporting the 2nd Generation, who have come into the world for the first time in 10 years.

A test assuming real combat.
The schedule would be impossible for ordinary Psychics, but after a short rest, the 2nd Generation can work almost on par with SoulWorkers.
It can be said they have infinite potential.

Unkown3:

Unkown3:

Unkown3:

Unkown4: Take a break at [Tower of Lord]

Unkown3:

An ordinary Psychic, but I evaluated his drive and potential and hired him as a special case.
I hope he will fill the vacancy left by the 2nd Generation member who failed and was taken away.
Unkown4: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Stench of War] of [Broken Way]

Unkown3:
That old man seems to be telling the 2nd Generation all sorts of things again.
Even after coming out of the training ground, nothing seems to change.

I conducted the final evaluation of the 2nd Generation SoulWorkers.
They seem to fight not for Starry Forest or humanity but for the Great Mother.
By whatever method, as long as they can produce energy, that is fine.
Unkown4: Proceed with Battle Evaluation in [Final Mission] of [Broken Way]

Unkown3:
In the end, only a few remained.
Moreover, they do not seem to get along, which is worrying for the future.

The first place we headed was Grace City in the west.
The commander, Toru, did not seem to welcome us much.
They apparently dislike us, who came from the east, but since it was the Lords' order, they had no particular objection.
Friction between west and east will likely continue.
Unkown4: Go to [Grace City] to proceed with Special Missions Unit orders

Unkown3:
The mission given to the 2nd Generation SoulWorker special force was to investigate the Vacuum.
It was to investigate the western SoulWorkers and the Vacuum's energy and find a way to be reborn as true SoulWorkers.
For that, we went through Rocco Town to [Grasscover Camp], a [Safe Anomalous Vacuum].

A small survey team was already operating inside the Vacuum.
Many things seem to have happened even before we arrived.
[Martin], the survey team's commander, noticed my disguise but promised not to tell anyone.
If he did, I would be disposed of by the Lords.

The soul of the legendary SoulWorker [Tenebris] remained, and the 2nd Generation talked with it, but there were no particular results.
Rather, Tenebris apparently declared that the special force could never become SoulWorkers.

The special force seems to have received negative opinions from Tenebris.
Why do they not understand that forcing it will only get them killed?
Martin said he had somewhat misjudged the special force and offered to introduce a [good place] he knew.
Unkown4: Speak to many people in [Grasscover Camp]

Unkown3:
The place Martin introduced was an abandoned subway.
The 2nd Generation who went there seem to have seen illusions of the Great Mother.
It is a somewhat rough method, but it seems it will be effective.

Some of the special force were completely absorbed by the illusion and could not be investigated, but a few saw through it and escaped its influence completely.
There is no case yet of one becoming a complete SoulWorker.

Judging there was no particular progress, the operation was canceled.
First, we switched to collecting data on the Vacuum.
Unkown4: Clear [Reunion with a Soft Soul] in [Dreadful Echo]

Unkown3:
When I tried to talk with Tenebris about the future, I was only told that imitating SoulWorkers will not make you one.
Of course, I vaguely understand that too. It is just that my circumstances do not allow me to give up.

We were introduced to a park that lures people with illusions and then eats them, and the special force began investigating at once.
The illusion appeared as if welcoming the special force.
As the park investigation continued, members began to appear who were strongly affected by the illusions.

The illusion deceiving the special force vanished, and the real Great Mother appeared.
...What is the matter all of a sudden?
Unkown4: Clear [The Hunting Field of Predator] in [Maneater Garden]

Unkown3:
They seem to be pushed around quite a bit by the real Great Mother.
Now that the Lords have appeared, there is nothing I can do.

I can no longer grasp the special force's condition well.
Their Soul Energy shows a positive response to the stimulus... but it might be dangerous if this continues.
Lured by her Godmother, this 2nd Generation SoulWorker's gone to the factory while completely ignoring my orders; something needs to be done about this.
...I chased them and forcibly brought them back.

The special force has calmed down, but it will only get worse like this.
Should we withdraw here, or continue as we are...?
Unkown4: [Look for a way to change yourself]

Unkown3:
The special force was given a choice.
Deny who they are now and change, or accept who they are now...

They finished choosing to walk the same road as before.

Aaron and Block. With new members, we began the port city operation.
I met Beneris for the first time in a while, but she did not seem to want to act as if we were acquainted.

I met a person named Victor.
He was a person who extremely loathes Soul Junk.
It would not be strange for such a person to exist in a world like this.

Suddenly the camp was attacked by Soul Junk.
We decided to help so that the Lords' Sinkhole investigation would not be hindered.

The special force clearly lacks the formidable talent of the western SoulWorkers.
So we handle the Lords' missions safely and surely.
...There is no need to risk our lives and look to the world like the SoulWorkers of that time.

Unkown4: Clear [Defense Mission: The 1st Fleet] in [Transport Fleet]

Unkown3:
We discovered a large Soul Junk at sea.
The special force, which has already defeated a large one, takes on the challenge with confidence.

The man Victor seems to do a lot out of his loathing of Soul Junk.
The result of hatred... we cannot know without seeing it.

A man named Victor fled from the camp, so the special force went after him.
The person he is probably in contact with is...

I instructed the special force to keep following Victor.
There was a strange confidence in Victor's words that those who chase him will be the ones to suffer.

What we captured on the island was Vista, the Lords' Third Star.
He looks like a brat, but he is not someone to let your guard down around.

Vista, whose identity we exposed, naturally began staying at the camp.
A mass-produced human made by Cherry Blossom... a genius born from it with a miraculous probability.
There are many things about him I dislike.
Upon news of Nihil Kingdom's remnants who are usually only seen in the East are gearing up to battle, we started preparing for a counterattack.

Soldiers revived by the power of Arculus, Commander of Ten Thousand...
By what trick did they suddenly come back to life?
Unkown4: Speak to [Martin] in [Tainted with Blood of Honor]

Unkown3: The Special Missions Unit have gone with Vista and Martin to check the situation themselves; it seems they've brought back a bunch of useful data.

The western SoulWorkers failed their operation, and there was no longer any need to stay...
However, the Lords still seem to want something, so we stayed here.
Having the chance to use the dropship, we advanced beneath the Sinkhole.

Vista, who vanished from the camp... apparently dove even deeper while the dropship was stopped.
He must be out of his mind.

A parasitic Soul Junk that pierces human bodies with tentacles and sucks their energy.
It is called the natural enemy of all Psychics and SoulWorkers who use energy.
It seems Ned was researching something tremendous beneath the Sinkhole.
We obtained materials inside the Sinkhole and also investigated the cathedral further below.

Unkown2: The Dead of the Cold Space
Unkown3:
Vista... that brat stayed behind inside the Sinkhole again.
I do not know what he is investigating, but I would be grateful if he just died.

A perfect form made by attaching humans to parasites...
Aaron seemed to be quite shocked; perhaps something had happened to him in the past.

Ayame, the First Star, suddenly appeared in Dipluce.
...What did that old woman come all this way for?

On the old woman's orders, further investigation of the Sinkhole was forced through.
She had eyes as if expecting something, but it would be hard to know what she intended.

Reports kept coming in from the special force that they had seen illusions of Tenebris.
Something seems to be happening beneath the Sinkhole.
Unkown4: Clear [Heroes' Failure] in [Dawn of Fate] after speaking to [Aaron]

Encounters with Tenebris's illusions are becoming more frequent.

That old woman said she would go to see [Tenebris] herself.
She will probably take the special force... surely no one will die.

The special force apparently fought Tenebris.
But as expected, it was not the real one, just an illusion.

We did everything there was to investigate in the Sinkhole, but the instruction the special force received from the Lords was...
To go to the west and continue taking the Lords' orders.

Unkown3:
I checked the situation in Grace.
As expected, the westerners harbor resentment toward us in the east.
Toru, following the advice of operations officer Senia, was reluctant from the start.

We continued investigating the snowy mountain where the enemy was said to have appeared.

Heitz and Martin have finally found the location where Vista is believed to be located. No time to hesitate. They immediately called SoulWorkers. Once known as Paradise Island, Haven Island was rich in trade with Arcadia Realm. But now there is no light and no human footprint. Unkown2: To the Quiet Island of Heaven
Unkown3: The SoulWorkers arrive at Heaven Island. They cannot hide their shock at the sight of the island, now a complete ruin. Ruins where only traces of human life remain, and swarms of Vacuum Junk attacking. Fighting the Vacuum Junk, the SoulWorkers notice that their bodies feel heavier than usual.

Breaking through the swarms of attacking Vacuum Junk, the SoulWorker party finds a huge research facility. Its size is so great that it distorts perspective, and convinced that Vista is there, the party heads straight for the facility without hesitation.

On the way to the research facility, Heitz, who cannot stop coughing, finally collapses in agony. The SoulWorkers return from Heaven Island to check on Heitz's condition and visit Sedurin to find the cause of Heitz's suffering.

After examining Heitz, Sedurin asks them to enter the island again with a signal amplification tracker. With the tracker they can find the specific wavelength spreading across the island, so Sedurin requests an active investigation.

Using the signal amplification tracker, the SoulWorkers find a machine that produces a specific wavelength and learn that it turned the island's residents into Vacuum Junk. Shaking with rage, they destroy the machine, but their joy is short-lived, as a wolf appears before the party.
The SoulWorker party advanced, following the wolf. They arrived at the entrance of a laboratory. And as if guarding the laboratory, two more wolves appeared before them.
Heitz recovers, and the SoulWorkers, having cleared a route to the research facility, can finally enter. Before entering, Heitz calls Thomas and tells him to accompany the SoulWorkers, but...

The SoulWorkers wander the research facility without a map. No matter how far they walk, there is no end in sight, and they grow anxious that Vista may slip away. Then a mysterious girl suddenly appears. After telling the SoulWorkers the way to Vista's laboratory, the girl disappears.

Relying on the mysterious girl's words, the SoulWorkers move through the research facility, but find no end however far they go and grow exhausted. They calm Thomas, who is angry that they should not have taken the girl at her word, and set out to learn her identity.
